propositions: Cancelled ACLI link delete (non-zero exit, no idempotent marker) is counted as links_applied instead of links_failed, fabricating success in batch_outcome reports.

Root cause: link create/delete subcommands prompt for confirmation; with stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL the prompt reads EOF and ACLI reports 'command cancelled', which the current except CalledProcessError arm treats as idempotent 404/409 without validating the error text.
The silent-noop canary cannot detect this defect because it tests (computed > 0 and applied == 0), but the miscounting arm inflates applied to equal computed.
The missing --yes flag on both link subcommands (accepted per acli 1.3.19-stable help; already used on workitem delete for bug 3256) causes the prompt-on-EOF failure mode.

Idempotent link removal races (genuine concurrent deletes) must be distinguished from prompt-cancellation failures by matching idempotent markers (404/409/does-not-exist/not-found) on either stderr OR stdout, not stderr alone.

The fix requires narrowing the exception handler to genuinely idempotent signatures, adding a _links_failed counter, passing --yes to both link commands, and ensuring links_failed appears in batch_outcome output.
